# victorzhou.com

> > A software engineer's blog exploring machine learning, neural networks, web development, and security through tutorials and interactive guides.

Victor Zhou's personal blog features in-depth tutorials on Python, Keras, and machine learning fundamentals, alongside web development and security best practices. The site combines educational content with interactive demonstrations to help developers understand complex technical concepts.

## Key Topics

- Machine Learning
- Neural Networks
- Keras
- Python
- Deep Learning
- Web Security
- JavaScript
- Recurrent Neural Networks
- Convolutional Neural Networks
- Web Development
- CSRF
- XSS
- Decision Trees
- Random Forests
- Interactive Demos

## Getting Started

- [Home](https://victorzhou.com): Software engineer's blog homepage covering web dev, ML, and neural networks.
- [About Me](https://victorzhou.com/about): About Victor Zhou: career, projects, and open-source contributions.
- [Top Posts](https://victorzhou.com/top): Curated collection of top posts on ML, neural networks, and Python.

## Machine Learning & Neural Networks

- [Keras for Beginners Series](https://victorzhou.com/series/keras-for-beginners): Beginner series on Keras: neural networks, RNNs, and CNNs in Python.
- [Keras for Beginners: Implementing a Recurrent Neural Network](https://victorzhou.com/blog/keras-rnn-tutorial): Beginner-friendly RNN implementation guide using Keras in Python.
- [One-Hot Encoding, Explained](https://victorzhou.com/blog/one-hot): Tutorial on one-hot encoding for categorical data preprocessing.

## Web Security

- [Web Security 101: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Attacks](https://victorzhou.com/blog/xss): Interactive guide to XSS attacks and prevention techniques.
- [Web Security 101: An Interactive Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) Demo](https://victorzhou.com/blog/csrf): Hands-on CSRF attack tutorial with interactive demonstration.

## Web Development

- [A Simple Guide to Dark Mode with Gatsby.js](https://victorzhou.com/blog/dark-mode-gatsby): Tutorial on implementing dark mode with Gatsby.js and React.
- [No More Excuses: Lazy Load Your Images](https://victorzhou.com/blog/lazy-loading-images): Guide to lazy loading images for web performance optimization.

## Updates & Reflections

- [2022 Update](https://victorzhou.com/blog/2022-update): Year-in-review update on blog growth and personal projects.
